lines.text: *Whoooosh!*
*Bang!* *Crackle!*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ah...
We part lips, and Arcana leans into me.
I wrap my arms around her and look up to watch the fireworks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I... never imagined I'd get to see this in my life.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm really, really happy!
Yeah, me too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: And that concludes the M.M.R. Vocational School's very first festival.

lines.speaker: announcement
lines.text: A huge thank you to everyone who came out to celebrate with us.
The PA system crackles to life, and the guests start trickling out of the school.
It's over...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it went by in a flash.
Arcana's hand that I've been holding all this time tightens slightly.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: {AccountData.NickName}, there's one last place I want to drop by...
Let's go.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You're not even gonna ask where?
Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why not?
Because I'll go anywhere with you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: And if I said we're going to the netherworld together?
Nah, that's a hard nope from me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh*
I'll save you, so we don't have to go to the netherworld together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Heh, so saving me once isn't enough, huh?
I walk with Arcana, talking about nothing in particular.
She doesn't say where we're going,
yet our footsteps carry us to the same destination.
The door slid open with a rattling clatter.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: As I thought, we've got the place to ourselves.
I guess everyone's resting now.
Arcana moves silently through the dark classroom,
her fingertips trailing softly over the desks.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ahhh... so it's really over.
It was hectic, but...
Arcana clasps her hands behind her back and turns toward me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It was fun, right?
Yeah, totally.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I feel the same.
Arcana stands with her back to the window, arms spread wide.
I slowly step closer and cup her face...
*Clatter!*
A clatter echoes, and a shadowy figure appears near the podium...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Kyaaaaaaa!

lines.speaker: unknown
lines.text: Yaaahhh!
Ahhhhhh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A-Amy?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What are you doing over there?

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: W-well...

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: After the festival ended, I came back to the classroom to take one last look.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Then you two walked in, and... I didn't want to spoil the mood, so I stayed quiet...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: D-don't laugh!
Hehe.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Not you too, {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow... we're really living our youth to the fullest, huh?
Tell me about it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Hey Amy, close your eyes for just a sec, will you?
Just a sec?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: *Sigh* Fine,

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I'll head off first... See you tomorrow...
The door slid open with a rattling clatter,
just as our lips are about to meet...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Huh? What are you guys doing in here?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Cough, cough!*
Arcana starts coughing violently and falls onto the desk.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ah, there you are.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hehe, I guessed you'd be here.
Looking past Ein, Zwei, and Rei, I see...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So, everyone's here after all.
Privaty and the rest of Class P enter the classroom one by one.
Wh-what's going on?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I wasn't ready to crash yet,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: so I thought I'd see if anyone else was around, and sure enough!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We've still got a little time before curfew.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: C'mon, who's up for an after-party?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: But we're all out of food.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Heh, we can just buy some real quick!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: I've got some snacks back at the dorm.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: All right, Amy, let's go together.
Roles are assigned in an instant, and the party starts coming together.
My eyes meet Arcana's.
Let's push the desks together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Okay!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ahh, I'm stuffed!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That was delicious...
Did we actually finish all that?
Feels like it could've fed an entire day's worth of customers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We're young and in our prime, after all!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It's almost curfew.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's start clearing up.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hold on!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's take one last photo together!
As a group?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yep yep, a group photo of Class P!
Now that I think about it, we've never taken a group photo.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Heck yeah!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Let's get these desks out of the way!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You got it!
Everyone pushes the desks to the back of the classroom,
and a few students start doodling on the blackboard.
I'll take the picture, so Privaty, why don't you go stand over there?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Okay, I guess...
The other students take their places next to Privaty, who's standing there a little awkwardly.
Okay, I'll take it.
*Click, click*
Even as I keep taking photos, my eyes keep finding Arcana.
She's laughing and chatting with the students beside her, her face turned slightly away.
One more!
Right before I press the shutter,
she brushes her hair back and smiles at me.
*Click, click*
Okay, last one!
And then...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wait a sec!
Huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: My name is Arcana from Class P at the M.M.R. Vocational School,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and I've got something to tell you, {AccountData.NickName}!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ooh, are you about to tell him you feel? In front of everyone?!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah! Now's my only shot!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Here I go.
Arcana takes a deep breath.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Now that I have your attention...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You've always been someone I can lean on,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you always treat me like I'm special,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and I know that you love me, {AccountData.NickName}!
... Arcana suddenly dialed up the theatrics.
It's our unspoken rule to indicate that she's just in character.
But right now...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You make...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: everything I do feel meaningful.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You risk your life for us,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you've given me back half of my world...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really, really...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... really, really love you!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: ... Wow!

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Ahhhhhhh!

lines.speaker: students
lines.text: Ask her out! Ask her out!
Guys, we're already dating...
I look into Arcana's eyes.
The certainty there is even stronger than when we stood under the cherry blossoms not long ago.
Her confidence in her feelings, as well as in mine, is unmistakable.
I can't find the right words to respond...
So instead...
I open my arms toward her.
She dashes across the classroom,
closing the short distance between us in an instant. Her eyes stay locked on mine,
carrying more emotion than words could ever hold.
Her aquamarine hair trails behind her like petals caught in the wind.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm never letting go...!
... And finally, Arcana's in my arms.
The scent of spring teases my nose...
*Click*
And so, our brilliant youth has come to an end.
A time that felt both fleeting and endless.
During that time, we loved, we fought...
Wait, scratch that. We didn't fight at all.
Anyway!
*Scratch, scratch*
Aw, what a shame...
I lost count of how many times I wished this dream could last forever.
But...
Dreams don't last forever...
Memories, though? Those can stay with us for a lifetime.
Yeah... even memories as dream-like as this one.
*Beep*
Oh, a message from Amy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... A photo?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe, all that practice for nothing, huh?
It's a photo Amy snapped on her phone in a hurry.
All the time we spent honing our technique has gone to waste.
It's just an ordinary photo with no finesse or flair.
But in that photo,
{AccountData.NickName} and I...
No,
all of our youth is captured in it.
2x2 Love: Arcana - Real Ending (1)
